sites.name: Sly Guard Cabin
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: The Sly Guard Cabin is less remote than other cabins on the Eldorado National forest and is a great choice for families with children. Sly Guard provides the cabin in the woods experience with the convenience of modern amenities. The cabin is near Sly Park Reservoir, also called Jenkinson Lake,…
sites.directions: From Highway 50, take the Sly Park exit at Pollock Pines, turn right on Sly Park road for 6 miles. Check in is done in person at the Placerville Ranger Station 4260 Eight Mile Rd., Camino Ca. 95709.

sites.name: Bridal Veil Group Area And Picnic Ground
sites.operator: USDA Forest Service · Eldorado National Forest
sites.about: Bridal Veil Group Campsite and Picnic Area is located on the South Fork of the American River. It offers picnicking sites, a group overnight area, beautiful swimming holes, and close access to fishing. Bridal Veil Group Area is on a hill overlooking the river and day use area. The group area…

sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Black Oak Campground is group camping destination near Stumpy Meadows Lake on the Eldorado National Forest. The forest boasts over 400 miles of hiking trails and an abundance of lakes and rivers for fishing and swimming.
sites.directions: 21 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs Road.
sites.restrictions: In units 1, 3, & 4, all vehicles must be kept in the unit’s central parking area. No trailers are allowed because of the difficulty of getting trailers in and out of these areas. sites.reservations: Reservations are required. Call 1-877-444-6777 or go to Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted. Interagency Senior/Access/Annual passes do not apply to Group facilities.

sites.name: Stumpy Meadows Campground
sites.feeText: $28/ single site. $56/ double site. $28/overnight camp on the boatramp. $10/day use. Other fees: Dumping waste tank and extra vehicle fees = $10.00.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Stumpy Meadows, on the Stumpy Meadows Reservoir, provides an enjoyable setting in a heavy conifer forest with easy access to an array of water activities. sites.name: Ponderosa Cove Group Campground
sites.feeText: $175/ group of 75 people. There are also fees for extra vehicle, pets, and wood is available for purchase from host. 5 vehicle spurs and a parking area for 10 vehicles.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Ponderosa Cove greets group campers with shaded campsites close to scenic Stumpy Meadows Reservoir. The campground provides a pleasant destination for bird watching and nature viewing, in addition to activities at the lake.
sites.directions: 17 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs road. East of the dam on the north side of the road.
sites.restrictions: Please check with the campground attendant or entrance board before setting up your camp. Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. sites.name: West Point Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: West Point Campground is located on the northwest shore of Union Valley reservoir off of North Union Valley Road. There are 22 sites ranging from single to triple in capacity. There is a boat ramp with access to the reservoir. The campground and boat ramp are at 4,875 feet in elevation.
